title: Watch Steamboat’s Winter Carnival come alive
description: Steamboat Springs fills its winter carnival with traditions that could only happen in a ski town: horses pull skiers down a snowy street, local families gather, and the nighttime show lights up Howelsen Hill. Choose a street event or the evening extravaganza and let the town’s enthusiasm carry you. It is part sporting event, part community celebration.
teaser: See skijoring and a glowing night show in Steamboat.
goodToKnow: Check the current carnival program and choose a comfortable viewing spot for outdoor events.
whyItMightDelightYou: The best part is how proudly the town turns its winter skills into a celebration everyone can share.
